claims.statement: The HAK-011 integration validator accepts the materialized cancelled HAK-007 provider run only when the exact subject, plan, run/attempt, workflow, terminal job, and receipt digest joins remain intact.
A terminal provider run with zero reported steps cannot manufacture per-check ProviderBound evidence or Passed conformance obligations.
A cancelled no-step qualification attempt yields NotSatisfied plan conformance while claim interpretation remains InsufficientEvidence rather than Qualified or semantically disproven.
Canonical receipt, conformance, interpretation, and real-evidence-capsule digests detect the tested forms of post-materialization tampering.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile inherited HAK evidence tooling plus scripts/hak_real_evidence_lint.py under Python 3.12.
Validate HAK-011 capsule schema syntax and representative real-evidence document with Draft 2020-12 jsonschema.
Lint the HAK-011 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-011 precommitted check-binding policy against the exact HAK-011 plan.
Validate the materialized cancelled HAK-007 provider evidence capsule end to end.
Run focused HAK-011 real-provider integration regressions.

required_negative_cases: cancelled no-step run contains Passed obligation
cancelled no-step run fabricates provider check evidence
real evidence capsule receipt digest mismatch
real evidence capsule conformance digest mismatch
real evidence capsule interpretation digest mismatch
schema accepts nonempty provider_check_evidence for no-step fixture

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-011 integration-tool behavior; the historical provider snapshot itself remains provider-observed, not cryptographically attested
